english.note: With programme approval, in-person applicants may be admitted with TOEFL80–91(old)/4.5(new),IELTS 6.5,orDET115–124, requiring arrival ESLAT and successful first-semester completion of any recommended ESL courses. IELTS Indicator7 accepted; no combined scores or IELTS One Skill Retake. Scores valid two years to enrollment. Exemption:US bachelor;US graduate/professional degree within five years;foreign bachelor exclusively English;or two graded full-time exclusively English-taught semesters within five years,excluding English-learning courses,with verified language of instruction.

applicationFee.note: International total75base+6processing. Graduate School grants require US citizenship/permanent residence. Programme grants may use other criteria, but no specific international-eligible offer for this programme was confirmed. Up to three programmes in one term share one paid application fee. Eligible Graduate School requests are due at least five business days before the earliest deadline. The fee-grant page says new program grant purchases are suspended until further notice; confirm any departmental grant availability.

requirements.note: Central bachelor-equivalent degree before enrollment; GPA3.0 last60 undergraduate credits or master cumulative3.0. Programme-specific conditions below also apply. Substantial prior research experience expected. Guide lists last60 undergraduate GPA3.0. GRE optional; absence does not affect consideration.

funding.note: Every domestic/international admission offer includes full stipend and tuition waiver as RA,fellow or trainee. Single/family health plans subsidized. No numerical Fall2027 stipend stated.

timeline.interviews: Programme plans invitations December2026 and2027 interview weeks:online faculty interviews plus in-person weekend visits for invited students residing in North America. Programme covers those visits; no general international airfare guarantee.
